prompt: How many units does an order line hold on average in each country? Use the sales table and all its order lines. Return two columns, in this order: country_code and units_per_line, the total of units divided by the number of order lines, rounded to 2 decimals with ROUND(x, 2). Count every order line, including a line whose units value is missing: a missing units value adds nothing to the total, but the line still counts. Return one row per country_code. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the calculated column units_per_line: a total of units divided by a count of lines, for each country_code.
Both SUM(units) and COUNT(*) are whole numbers. Make one side a decimal before you divide, so the division keeps its decimals on every engine, and put ROUND with 2 decimals around the whole result.
why_this_works: Multiplying the whole-number total by 1.0 makes the division keep its decimals on every engine, and COUNT(*) counts the lines with a missing units value too.
